# JetBrains Mono (latin variable, slashed zero baked into default cmap).

#

# Regenerated from the official JetBrains Mono variable release with:

# pyftfeatfreeze -f zero JetBrainsMono[wght].ttf

# then latin-subset + woff2 via fontTools.

#

# Fontsource/Google builds strip the `zero` OpenType feature, so we vendor

# the official font with the alternate zero remapped as default.
